# Roamie built-in music

**Wander** and **Sunset** are original procedural instrumental compositions generated by Roamie's memory renderer. They contain no third-party recordings or sampled performances.

The compositions and generated audio are dedicated to the public domain under **CC0 1.0 Universal**: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . They may be used, edited, downloaded and shared without attribution, including in exported trip videos. This dedication covers these compositions/audio, not third-party or user-uploaded music.

The user retains responsibility for permission to use music they select from their own files. Roamie does not obtain rights to commercial tracks or pull music from streaming services.
